description: Recommend the right 3D2HOLO workflow when the user wants to turn existing visual content into a lenticular 3D photo and their source type is known: a single photo, multi-angle photos, a GLB/GLTF 3D model, a Sketchfab model, or AI-generated multi-view images. The tool returns the recommended workflow steps and where to start. Scope: workflow selection for a specific input type; the tool does not provide product overviews, print-parameter math, calibration charts, or price estimates.
name: get_workflow_guide
title: Choose the right 3D photo workflow
